how_to_choose.heading: Look slowly. Ask clearly. Choose freely.
how_to_choose.intro: A gemstone can be beautiful before it is perfect, rare, or expensive. Start with what you notice, then ask what can be known.

1.heading: Begin with colour and character
1.body: Notice the colour in different light, the shape, the cut, and the natural features that make the stone individual.

2.heading: Read the description carefully
2.body: Weight, dimensions, treatment, origin opinions, and reports answer different questions. Unknown information should remain visible as unknown.

3.heading: Separate fact from interpretation
3.body: A laboratory conclusion, a supplier statement, and a personal impression do not carry the same certainty. Rubiae labels the source of each claim.

4.heading: Ask before deciding
4.body: Ask about the report, treatment, visible features, photography, or anything that affects your choice. A careful question is part of choosing well.

5.heading: Choose on your terms
5.body: You do not need a dramatic reason. You may choose for colour, curiosity, a private milestone, or simply because the stone feels right to you.

about.heading: A quieter way to choose a gemstone.

paragraphs.1: Rubiae brings natural gemstones into view without turning them into promises about the person who chooses them.
paragraphs.2: We believe in looking slowly, describing honestly, and leaving space for personal meaning. The stone is presented with its character and the evidence available; the choice remains yours.
paragraphs.3: Rubiae is being built in the Netherlands. The public site is currently a preview, while the collection, reports, and future service are prepared with care.

for_trade.heading: Clear stones. Clear information.
for_trade.intro: Rubiae is preparing a focused supply of coloured gemstones for jewellers, designers, collectors, and other professional buyers.
for_trade.process_heading: A professional enquiry starts with the facts.
for_trade.process_body: Tell us the material, format, quantity, quality range, and documentation you need. Wholesale inventory, pricing, and terms are shared only after professional-buyer verification.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: This notice explains how {{ legal_name }}, trading as Rubiae, uses personal data on {{ domain }}.
privacy.data_collected: We collect the information you choose to provide in contact and interest forms: name, email address, preferred language, stone ID, optional message, and any separate launch-notification consent.
privacy.purpose: We use enquiry data to answer your request and maintain a record of the conversation. We use launch-notification data only after separate consent and email confirmation.
privacy.legal_basis: We process enquiries to take steps at your request and, where applicable, for our legitimate interest in answering and documenting genuine enquiries. We send launch notifications only with consent.
privacy.sharing: We share data only with service providers needed to operate the website, forms, email, and security. They may include Shopify and the providers listed in the current processor register. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.international: If a provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, we use the safeguards described by that provider and required by applicable law.
privacy.retention: Unconverted enquiries are kept for up to 12 months. Launch-notification data is removed when you unsubscribe or after 24 months without interaction, unless a shorter period is required.
privacy.rights: You may ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to certain processing. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.
privacy.contact: Email {{ privacy_email }}. You may also complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
